Lemma
1. Lemma 1.11\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0010 ↗ hanlin:thm-harmonic-mean-value

If $u\ge 0$ is harmonic in $B_R(x_0)$ and continuous on its closure, then \[ |Du(x_0)|\le \frac nR u(x_0). \]
Proof

\sketch Use the boundary formula from Lemma 1, replace $|\nu _i|$ by $1$, and use nonnegativity together with the mean value identity for the boundary integral.

□
